title: Characterization of epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG)-phosphorylated hemoglobin for changing pork meat quality: from simulations to applications.
authors: Wang, Yanli; Liu, Lili; Cheng, Weiwei; Zhang, Xinshuai; Ding, Yue
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和神经网络指导血红蛋白的磷酸化与EGCG修饰，以改善猪肉品质，虽涉及蛋白结构计算但核心是食品应用，方法创新有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The valorization of hemoglobin (Hb) from meat processing by-products is essential for sustainable recycling. However, this process is severely constrained by the inherent limitations of Hb, such as poor stability and low solubility. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a computationally guided dual-modification strategy. This approach integrates covalent phosphorylation with epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG)-mediated non-covalent interactions to enhance the applicability of modified Hb. RESULTS: Artificial neural network prediction and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were employed to rationalize the modification process. MD simulations and binding energy calculations revealed that the stability of the complex is driven by specific amino acid residues, with ALA142, ASN139 and THR38 making the most significant contributions through robust hydrogen bonding networks. Spectroscopic analysis confirmed that this interaction with EGCG drastically reduced the alpha-helix content (from 74% to 30%), inducing a conformational opening that exposed cryptic hydrophobic pockets. The modified Hb exhibited superior surface hydrophobicity, antioxidant activity and foaming capacity. Crucially, application in a pork meat sausage model demonstrated that the EGCG-phosphorylated porcine hemoglobin (EGCG-PHb) complex effectively acted, overcoming the severe gel brittleness caused by phosphorylation and significantly enhancing the springiness and chewiness of the meat matrix. CONCLUSION: The protein structure of the EGCG-PHb complex was significantly altered compared to Hb, and EGCG-PHb complex also significantly improved the springiness and chewiness of pork sausages. This dual-modification strategy provides new insights into the development and utilization of Hb. (c) 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
abstract_zh: 背景：从肉类加工副产物中回收利用血红蛋白（Hb）对于可持续循环至关重要。然而，该过程受到Hb固有局限性（如稳定性差和溶解度低）的严重制约。为克服这些挑战，本研究提出了一种计算引导的双重修饰策略。该策略将共价磷酸化与表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）介导的非共价相互作用相结合，以增强修饰后Hb的适用性。结果：采用人工神经网络预测和分子动力学（MD）模拟来合理化修饰过程。MD模拟和结合能计算表明，复合物的稳定性由特定氨基酸残基驱动，其中ALA142、ASN139和THR38通过稳健的氢键网络贡献最为显著。光谱分析证实，与EGCG的相互作用大幅降低了α-螺旋含量（从74%降至30%），诱导构象开放，暴露了隐藏的疏水口袋。修饰后的Hb表现出优异的表面疏水性、抗氧化活性和起泡能力。关键的是，在猪肉香肠模型中的应用表明，EGCG-磷酸化猪血红蛋白（EGCG-PHb）复合物有效发挥作用，克服了磷酸化引起的严重凝胶脆性，并显著增强了肉基质的弹性和咀嚼性。结论：与Hb相比，EGCG-PHb复合物的蛋白质结构发生显著改变，且EGCG-PHb复合物还显著改善了猪肉香肠的弹性和咀嚼性。该双重修饰策略为Hb的开发利用提供了新见解。（c）2026化学工业学会。
